fusions.name: Rote Incision
fusions.desc: A practised cut that deals 7 damage and lodges coral grit in the wound: the target is [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds, and each tick has a 30% chance to crit. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Textbook Spurs
fusions.desc: Raises a ring of coral spurs that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Studied Stillness
fusions.desc: After 2 seconds of holding still, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 30 seconds.

fusions.name: Laid Down by Practice
fusions.desc: Every ability you use lays a stack on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full) before your health takes damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
